name: @styloviz/barcode-1d
description: Code 128, EAN-13 and EAN-8 rendered as SVG from a real encoder: mod-103 and mod-10 check characters computed rather than trusted, EAN-13's leading digit carried in the left-half parity, subset-C packing so a long serial fits the label, spec quiet zones, and a module width snapped to whole device…
author: sazzad-bs23
